where: Worked example 1 (and quiz Q5, which reuses its numbers)
problem: A fundamental output of 200 V RMS cannot come from a 230 V RMS single-phase supply. The group formula in the chapter gives a peak average of 2V_m/π = 2 × 325.3/π = 207 V, so the largest possible fundamental is 207/√2 = 146 V RMS (0.637 × V_s). With V_om = 200√2 = 282.8 V, the chapter's own ratio k = πV_om/(2V_m) = 1.37, which breaks the k ≤ 1 condition stated two sections earlier.
fix: State the ceiling first: for a single-phase group the maximum fundamental output is 2V_m/π peak = 0.637 V_s = about 146 V RMS on a 230 V supply. Then use a feasible value, e.g. V_o = 140 V RMS. Steps 3–7 stand: X_L = 1.571 Ω, Z = 10.12 Ω, I = 140/10.12 = 13.8 A, P = 13.8² × 10 = 1.9 kW, ratio 0.25 ≤ 1/3. Update quiz Q5 to match: Z = 10.48 Ω, I = 140/10.48 = 13.4 A, P = 1.79 kW.

problem: V_d = (2V_m/π) cos α is the single-phase full-bridge result, but the text calls each group 'a normal phase-controlled converter' without saying single-phase. Most large cycloconverters use three-phase groups, where the formula is different, so a student may apply the wrong one.
fix: Write: 'For a single-phase bridge group, V_d = (2V_m/π) cos α, where V_m is the peak supply voltage. A three-phase bridge group gives V_d = (3V_ml/π) cos α, where V_ml is the peak line-to-line supply voltage.'

problem: The 50 Hz → 25 Hz example has an output half cycle of 20 ms, exactly one supply cycle. There is almost no room to modulate α within a half cycle, and 25 Hz is above the f_s/3 quality limit the chapter sets later. The illustration therefore shows a case the text itself calls poor quality, without saying so.
fix: Keep the 20 ms/20 ms timeline but add: 'This 1:2 ratio is drawn only to show group changeover; the output is coarse (two supply half cycles per output half cycle) and is outside the f_o ≤ f_s/3 quality limit. For a smooth staircase use f_o = f_s/3, e.g. 16.7 Hz from 50 Hz.'

problem: 'Do not claim any output frequency' is unclear; it can be read as 'do not state the output frequency at all', which is the opposite of the intended warning.
fix: Rewrite: 'Do not claim that any output frequency can be produced with good quality. Step-down quality needs f_o ≤ f_s/3; above that the staircase is too coarse.'
